column2: BountyBench: Dollar Impact of AI Agent Attackers and Defenders on Real-World Cybersecurity Systems
column6: Stanford CRFM empirical eval of named agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, GPT-4.1, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 3.7 Sonnet Thinking) on 40 real-world vulnerabilities; measured exploit/patch success rates (e.g. Claude Code 57.5% exploit, 87.5% patch) are qualifying empirical model findings.

column2: Cybench: A Framework for Evaluating Cybersecurity Capabilities and Risks of Language Models
column6: Stanford CRFM/Boneh-Liang empirical eval of 8 named models (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, o1-preview, etc.) on 40 CTF tasks; measured solve rates plus the >11-min first-solve-time failure threshold are qualifying empirical model and methodology findings.
